# FlattenUnions: nested unions, several classes in one union, number
# conflation, `any` members, and the done flag.
builder prov
prim i integer
prim d double
str s unrestricted
prim nul null
prim b bool
cls a x:i,y:s n=A
cls c x:d,z?:b n=C
union inner a,nul n=Inner
union outer inner,c,i n=Outer
union nums i,d n=Nums
arr arr outer
cls top o:outer,n:nums,arr:arr n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
print
query canonical 9
query canonical 8
flatten debug
print
flatten
gc
print

# Conflating numbers merges integer into double.
builder
prim i integer
prim d double
prim nul null
union nums i,d,nul n=Nums
uunion u2 n=Twice
members u2 nums,i
cls top n:nums,t:u2 n=Top
top Top top
finish
flatten conflate
print

# An `any` member absorbs the union.
builder prov
prim any any
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
union u any,i,s n=WithAny
cls top u:u n=Top
top Top top
finish
flatten
print
